text: 69 2. Read aloud. Off to Mars! 4.6 Baby Bear wanted to go to Mars. He asked Mamma Bear, ‘‘Can I go to Mars?’’ Mamma Bear replied, ‘‘Yes, you can, but you need to have a rocket to reach there.’’ Baby Bear found a broom lying on the floor. He said, ‘‘Here it is Mamma, can I go now?’’ Mamma Bear said, ‘‘No dear, you can’t go, you need to have a space helmet.’’ Baby Bear went to the kitchen and found a round shaped pot. He asked, ‘‘Now can I go to Mars?’’ Mamma Bear replied, ‘‘Yes dear, you can, but you have to wear space shoes.’’ Baby Bear found big boots on the shoe rack. He collected all the things and packed his bag. Now, he was ready for the adventure! Just then his mother woke him up, ‘‘Come on, wake up! It’s time to go to school.’’ 1. Observe the picture of planets.
